introHtml: Non slip shirts add a grippy texture to the fabric, helping tools, trays, or equipment stay put on the shoulder or chest. Safety managers in warehouses and kitchens choose these shirts to reduce dropped items while keeping employees visible. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a branded uniform that works as hard as your team.
